claim_boundary: NCU is the hardware counter oracle. HBServe profiles are fitted and holdout-checked against sparse captures; this matrix is calibration evidence until a fresh blind sparse holdout is admitted. The naive cache has no independent L1/L2, so cache-level relative errors are intentionally unavailable.
